# Audit 07 — Legacy Code

**Audit date:** 2026-09-29 · **Reviewed commit:** `0564118` (main) · **Deployed:** `v1.0.0` (`a00803b`).

Scope: demonstrably unused, unreachable, duplicated or obsolete code and configuration. Every item below was reference-checked with `grep` across `app/`, `routes/`, `config/`, `resources/`, `tests/`, `database/`, `.github/` before being labelled. Historical ADRs, retained migrations, compatibility handling and regression tests are **not** treated as obsolete.

## Verified **not** dead (kept deliberately)

| Item                                                                                                                                    | Why it stays                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `EmailParseErrorCode::UnsupportedTemplate`                                                                                              | Documented reserved case for future template branching (project sheet, Phase 1).                                                                                                                    |
| `MailboxRunStatus::Running` in the poll command `match`                                                                                 | Unreachable at runtime but required for `match` exhaustiveness; also the persisted in-flight status.                                                                                                |
| `0001_01_01_000002_create_jobs_table.php`, `QUEUE_CONNECTION=database`, `config/queue.php`, `config/mail.php`, `config/filesystems.php` | Framework defaults; nothing dispatches jobs or sends mail, but the tables/config are harmless and removing them deviates from the skeleton for no gain. `jobs`/`failed_jobs` are empty on the host. |
| `tests/Feature/ExampleTest.php`                                                                                                         | Repurposed to assert `/` → `/opportunities`; a real regression test, despite the scaffold name.                                                                                                     |
| `config/opportunity_sources.php`                                                                                                        | Fully consumed by `UpworkJobAlertParser` (5 call sites).                                                                                                                                            |
| `MailboxConfiguration` container singleton                                                                                              | Used by `WebklexImapMailboxClient` autowiring and one test; the commands bypass it (MNT-06) but it is not dead.                                                                                     |
| `webklex/php-imap` dependency while intake is disabled                                                                                  | Intake is a runtime flag, not a removed feature; the adapter remains the supported path.                                                                                                            |
| Retained release directory `fotp-before-v1-65bf4ea…` on the host                                                                        | Documented rollback target — but it also hosts the live `.env`/`storage` (REL-04), so it must not be treated as disposable.                                                                         |
| Historical quarantine rows (`malformed_terms` ×24 from 2026-08-31→09-04)                                                                | Terminal by design (ADR-004 quarantine-history constraint); evidence, not garbage.                                                                                                                  |
| ADR-004 "Redirect-Only Alert Canonicalization" sections                                                                                 | The resolver code was removed on 2026-09-04; the ADR retains the design/security review and the failed compatibility proof as history.                                                              |
| `compose.yaml` `mariadb_test` bound to `0.0.0.0:3307`                                                                                   | Local-only developer container; not production. Optional: bind to `127.0.0.1` like `mariadb_demo`.                                                                                                  |

## Missing verification

None — this category is fully assessable from the repository and the host listing. `build/` and `test-results/` local directories are ignored artefacts and were not treated as source.

## Review limits

Vendored code (`vendor/`, `node_modules/`) was not inventoried for dead code; it is managed by lockfiles and Dependabot. Compiled `public/build` assets were verified only by manifest presence and hash, not by content review.
